QUOTE: The section is rejected, and the build falls back to the whole repo with a WARNING, if it is not a mapping, has an unknown key (so `exclude:` for `excludes:` fails), or has no usable `roots:`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer mentions a WARNING on fallback, but it never says the fallback carries a reason recording which scope was used and why, so an unstated scope is never silently guessed.
